setting.label: Use YouTube Kodi plugin for playback
setting.description: Requires YouTube plugin to be installed. If not installed, will fallback to direct playback.

setting.label: Play a workout playlist
setting.description: Enable playback of a workout playlist during workouts.

setting.label: Workout Playlist
setting.description: Name of the playlist to use for workouts. Must already exist.

setting.label: Shuffle workout playlist
setting.description: If enabled, the workout playlist will play in shuffled order starting from a random track.

setting.label: Play a cooldown playlist
setting.description: Enable playback of a cooldown playlist after workouts.

setting.label: Cooldown Playlist
setting.description: Name of the playlist to use for cooldown. Must already exist.

setting.label: Shuffle cooldown playlist
setting.description: If enabled, the cooldown playlist will play in shuffled order starting from a random track.

setting.label: Default EMOM total minutes
setting.description: Default total length of EMOM workout in minutes.

setting.label: Default EMOM lap minutes
setting.description: Default length of each EMOM lap in minutes.

setting.label: Default Tabata work seconds
setting.description: Default work interval in seconds for Tabata.

setting.label: Default Tabata rest seconds
setting.description: Default rest interval in seconds for Tabata.

setting.label: Default AMRAP minutes
setting.description: Default length of AMRAP in minutes.
